newsitem.title: UK: Capital Shopping says Q1 retail sales ahead.
newsitem.headline: Capital Shopping says Q1 retail sales ahead.

text.p: British property developer Capital Shopping Centres said on Tuesday that trading at each of its centres during the first quarter of 1997 was ahead of national statistics.
Capital Shopping's chairman Donald Gordon told an annual meeting of shareholders that trading was also in line with the company's budget.
"...Particularly at the M25 centres which perhaps reflects the relatively buoyant economic conditions in the South East," he said.
Gordon said construction of a 250 million stg project at Braehead was on target and would open in Spring 1999.
Marks & Spencer and Sainsbury's would be among the customers in the new shopping centre.
